description: Dixon leans close to the clear cool window and his breath touches the glass
Dixon Discovers Why the Window Turns Cloudy
A cloudy patch appears exactly where Dixon breathed
Dixon tries one careful second breath and watches the fog spread
Dixon draws one clear line through the mist with a white mitten
Tiny droplets gather around the clear paw line
Purrcilla checks the far side of the pane and finds it clear
Dage looks from the warm room air to the cool window
Dixon compares the dry outside surface with the misty room side
Purrcilla warms a small corner with a cloth; that corner fogs less
Dage holds a cool coaster nearby and a faint mist forms on it too
Dixon notices that the cloud is made of many tiny droplets
Dixon connects warm moist breath, a cool surface, and the droplets
Cool glass turns water vapor into tiny droplets
Dixon celebrates when the warm corner stays clearer
All three quietly clear a small viewing patch together
A new breath cloud blooms beside their clear patch and Dixon knowingly smiles
